items.briefing:
Australians are being warned about active scams impersonating myGov and using fake invoices, according to a new Proofpoint alert. Separately, the National Anti-Scam Centre has reached out to more than 10,000 Australians caught up in an international cryptocurrency scam investigation — if you receive contact from them, take it seriously. A Sydney-based startup called Bugtri has also launched to help reduce the flood of low-quality AI-generated vulnerability reports hitting security teams.

If you receive an unexpected message claiming to be from myGov, do not click any links — go directly to myGov's official website by typing the address into your browser.

featured.title: Proofpoint warns of myGov & invoice scams in Australia
featured.quote: Australians lost AUD $2.18 billion to scams in 2025, with myGov impersonation as primary vector.
